name: 游侠笑传II
group_note: 游侠笑传II. Dual-encoding client support (prompts new connections to choose GB or BIG5 before login proceeds -- the BIG5-flavored prompt line is deliberately garbled when viewed as GBK, not a mojibake bug). WASM pass found and fixed a severe pre-existing (non-WASM-specific) bug: include/globals.h's SECURITY_D macro pointed at '/adm/obj/securityd', but the actual securityd.lpc file has always lived at 'adm/daemons/securityd.lpc' -- a path that was never valid. adm/etc/preload also referenced the wrong '/adm/obj/securityd' path, so master.lpc's own file_size()-gated preload() silently no-op'd on it (never actually loaded), and every OTHER preloaded daemon whose create() calls seteuid() (band, channeld, convertd, chinesed, combatd, fingerd, natured, saved, tengaoshou, tenrichman) crashed with 'call_other() couldn't find object /adm/obj/securityd' via master.lpc's unguarded valid_seteuid() -- worse, the very first player connection's logind.lpc create() (itself triggered via seteuid() during clone/user/login.lpc's compile) hit the same crash and the driver disconnected the user outright ('new_conn_handler: logon() ... has failed'). Fixed both the macro and the preload entry to the real path (also moved securityd to the FRONT of the preload list so every later daemon's seteuid() calls succeed). Also fixed: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese()/check_legal_name() bug (adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc's is_chinese() used a strlen%2 parity gate and str[0]-only byte check; adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_legal_name() had the matching i%2==0/[i..<0] pattern) -- both rewritten to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff checks, bounds halved from 2/12 to 1/6. (2) master.lpc (adm/single/master.lpc) valid_read()/valid_write() missing the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit -- added to both (securityd.lpc's save_object() fast-path already correctly used query_save_file()+__SAVE_EXTENSION__, no fix needed there). (3) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed across 49 call sites (mostly kungfu/skill/*.lpc roar/suck/zhua/shoot files using is_killing(me) and is_killing(ob[i]), plus d/city/npc/guidao.lpc, d/npc/robber.lpc, cmds/std/ansuan.lpc, cmds/std/surrender.lpc, cmds/std/nuoyi.lpc). (4) log/nosave/ directory was missing from the archive, causing a caught-but-visible 'Wrong permissions for opening file /log/nosave/wizdrop' on wizard item-drop logging -- created the directory. adm/daemons/httpd.lpc, adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc, and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are all dormant (httpd not referenced by preload at all; ftpd/dns_master commented out; remaining callers are just header macro definitions or already-guarded commands) -- left untouched. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (displays as '主管巫师' in this lib's Chinese wiz_levels labels). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (GB/BIG5 encoding select -> id -> y confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> gift-stat accept (y) -> email -> gender -> enters 客店), admin permission confirmed via '目前权限：(主管巫师)'. LPC formatter run across all 6493 .lpc files (6465 written, 28 pre-existing errors, 0 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits.
